attributes.board_name: Georgia State Board of Veterinary Medicine

rules.accepted_credit_types: Blanket approval: national, state and international veterinary association meetings; USDA and Georgia Dept. of Agriculture meetings; AVMA-recognized specialty boards; AVMA-accredited veterinary schools; AAVSB RACE; GVMA constituent organizations; AAHA; US/Southern Animal Health Association; courses approved by another state board. LEAP courses need Board approval
rules.new_licensee_rule: Licensed in the first year of a biennium: 5 hours (no LEAP needed); licensed in the second year: exempt for that renewal.
rules.audit_note: Random audits of up to 25% of licensees; keep records 3 years.

topics.who: Georgia laws, rules and professionalism (LEAP); not required for technicians who do not practice in Georgia

rules.notes: Max 4 h journal study or non-interactive computer courses (with testing); max 3 h in-house training at the workplace. Licenses expire Dec 31 of even years (Rule 700-7-.01).
